collection.description: A child gives another child a flower and receives no response.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) gives (other), another child, a flower and receives no response.

choices.label: Turn the Flower into a Game.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (other) was distracted and thanks them later.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) feels disappointed but respects their space.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) starts a flower-collecting contest with friends.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (other) joins the game without romantic expectations.
